title: Patch 20 - Reading Comprehension Integration
description: Adds Reading Comprehension as a full AFOQT subject with passage-based question clusters.

questionsPerPassageValidation.fallbackBehavior: If a passage has < 4 questions, still include it but flag as incomplete. If > 6 questions, truncate to first 6 or split into two passage groups.

passageClusteringEnforcement.rule: All questions for a passage must be presented together as a cohesive block.
passageClusteringEnforcement.validation: Loader must verify each passage JSON contains between 4-6 questions before adding to registry.
passageClusteringEnforcement.implementation: Group questions by passageId during test generation; do not interleave questions from different passages.

questionRoutingRules: 2. Each JSON contains a single passage and its question cluster.
3. Concatenate passage-clusters into a global pool by difficulty.
4. Randomly select passages according to difficultyMix.
uiIntegration: Use rc_passage_block to render the passage text at the top of the question group.
Use rc_question_block for each question under the passage.
Display passage once, followed by all associated questions in sequence.
In practice test mode, do not reveal correct answers until all passages are complete.
implementationNotes: Ensure grouped questions remain attached to their parent passage.
In practice test mode, hide explanations until all passages are complete.
Follow the AFOQT reading style: informational, neutral, concise.
